categories.main_business_segments: Darbond Technology primarily operates in high-end electronic packaging materials, focusing on four main product categories: integrated circuit packaging materials, smart terminal packaging materials, new energy application materials, and high-end equipment application materials. These products include electronic-grade adhesives and functional film materials used across semiconductor, consumer electronics, power batteries, and photovoltaic industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies revolve around formulation design, composite technology, and modification of base resins, fillers, and additives. It has developed proprietary platforms for epoxy, silicone, acrylic, and polyurethane electronic-grade resins and fillers, enabling rapid product iteration and customization. Production employs advanced processes such as reactive coating, automated dispensing, and precision film manufacturing, supported by intelligent manufacturing facilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading semiconductor packaging and testing companies, global consumer electronics brands like Apple and Huawei, major new energy vehicle battery manufacturers such as CATL and BYD, and photovoltaic module producers like Tongwei and LONGi. The company serves industries including semiconductors, smart terminals, new energy vehicles, energy storage, and photovoltaics.
categories.geographic_coverage: Darbond Technology operates primarily in China with production bases in Yantai, Kunshan, Dongguan, Suzhou, and Sichuan. It has expanded internationally with subsidiaries in Singapore and Vietnam to serve overseas markets and integrate into global supply chains. Major sales regions include East China, South China, other domestic regions, and overseas markets including Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the electronic packaging materials supply chain, producing critical materials used in semiconductor wafer processing, chip-level packaging, power device packaging, and module/system integration. It supplies materials directly to packaging and testing companies and OEMs in downstream industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Darbond focuses on technological innovation, product portfolio expansion, and market penetration in integrated circuits, smart terminals, and new energy sectors. It invests heavily in R&D (6.65% of revenue in 2023), developing advanced packaging materials like DAF/CDAF films, underfill adhesives, and thermal interface materials. The company emphasizes green, low-carbon materials and digital transformation of manufacturing and management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and distribution of high-end electronic packaging materials. The company employs both direct sales to key customers and buyout distribution agreements with authorized dealers to expand market coverage. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance, including consignment sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Darbond is a leading domestic player in high-end electronic packaging materials, competing with international giants such as Henkel, H.B. Fuller, Dow Chemical, and Dymax in smart terminal materials. It has achieved significant breakthroughs in semiconductor packaging materials, contributing to domestic substitution of imported products. The company holds a strong position in new energy materials and photovoltaic packaging sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Darbond reported revenues of approximately RMB 931.98 million, a slight increase of 0.37% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 102.95 million, down 16.31%. Total assets reached RMB 2.74 billion, growing 6.08%, and net assets attributable to shareholders were RMB 2.27 billion, up 2.96%. The company maintains steady growth with increased R&D investment and expanding production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Darbond emphasizes its comprehensive product solutions integrating structural bonding, conductivity, thermal management, insulation, protection, and electromagnetic shielding tailored for advanced packaging technologies. Its competitive edge lies in proprietary formulation technologies, high reliability under harsh conditions, rapid product iteration, and strong customer collaboration. The company also focuses on green, environmentally friendly materials and intelligent manufacturing to enhance product quality and cost efficiency.
